facts: Campaign scope: ghost_debug chased the 2026-06-09 ghost failure 'WiFi radio ON => VIO/FMU pipeline broken' (FINDINGS.md:3-5). Only tab1 (nvblox realsense_example.launch.py) + tab2 (px4_offboard vio_bridge.launch.py = MicroXRCEAgent serial /dev/ttyUSB0 @921600 + vio_bridge) were run — NO zenoh, LoRa/radiohive, exploration, or multi-drone nodes appear in any node list (run01/data/A_wifi_on/c_node_list.txt, c_pgrep.txt). All captures are on-bench, disarmed.

CONFIRMED root cause of that campaign (run03 PASS): DDS domain mismatch — ghost tmux script exports ROS_DOMAIN_ID=3 (run01/data/A_wifi_on/c_env.txt:3) while PX4 UXRCE_DDS_DOM_ID was 0; MicroXRCEAgent creates DDS entities on the domain the PX4 CLIENT requests, ignoring the container env, so /fmu/out/* lived on domain 0 and vio_bridge's /fmu/in/vehicle_visual_odometry on domain 3 never reached PX4 (POSTMORTEM.md:16-27). Fix = PX4 param UXRCE_DDS_DOM_ID=3 + FMU reboot; validated by run03 with WiFi ON and the unmodified script (POSTMORTEM.md:11-14, FINDINGS.md:22).

WiFi radio ruled OUT as cause: run01 phase A (wifi ON, associated TP-Link_073A 5765 MHz, -38 dBm, power_save off) showed /camera0/imu 200.06 Hz (c_hz_camera_imu.txt:1), /visual_slam/tracking/odometry 30.66 Hz (c_hz_vslam_odom.txt:2), /fmu/in/vehicle_visual_odometry 30.01 Hz (c_hz_fmu_in_vvo.txt:1), vio_bridge steadily at VIO #3800 (tab2_pane.txt:1726), no USB resets in dmesg. Also ruled out earlier: FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE loopback profile, ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1, NTP stepping (FINDINGS.md:12-15); journal_nm empty => no NetworkManager thrash (A_wifi_on/journal_nm.txt).

Radio state was CORRELATED, not causal: every radio-ON test used the SSH tmux script (domain 3), every radio-OFF 'working' test used launch_local.sh which sets NO ROS_DOMAIN_ID (=> domain 0, matching PX4's 0). Domain IDs (1=delta,2=buckshee,3=ghost,4=thunderstrike) were an UNCOMMITTED addition after last-known-good commit 9f5d549 'tests on all 4 drones successful' (POSTMORTEM.md:5-9,23-27, FINDINGS.md:33-39).

SENSOR TYPE ENUM: AirLib supports SensorType Barometer=1, Imu=2, Gps=3, Magnetometer=4, Distance=5, Lidar=6, Echo=7, GPULidar=8, SensorTemplate=9, MarlocUwb=10, Wifi=11 (/home/lucas/hercules-sim/HERCULES/AirLib/include/sensors/SensorBase.hpp:26-39). Cameras are NOT sensors — they are configured via per-vehicle 'Cameras' blocks (docs/sensors.md:19).

SENSOR JSON SHAPE: each sensor is declared under Vehicles.<name>.Sensors.<key> with {"SensorType": <int>, "Enabled": true, ...} — parsed at AirSimSettings.hpp:1640-1665. If no Sensors block, Multirotor/Hero modes auto-add imu+magnetometer+gps+barometer defaults (AirSimSettings.hpp:1680-1685).

DOWNWARD 1D LIDAR (Distance sensor): SensorType 5 with keys X,Y,Z (NED m), Yaw/Pitch/Roll (deg), MinDistance (default 0.2), MaxDistance (default 40.0), ExternalController (default true = forwarded to PX4 as MAVLink DISTANCE_SENSOR). Point at ground with "Pitch": -90 (/home/lucas/hercules-sim/HERCULES/docs/distance_sensor.md:1-24).

D435i-LIKE RGBD AT 20 DEG DOWN: declare per-vehicle Cameras.<cam_name> with CaptureSettings array entries per ImageType (Width, Height, FOV_Degrees, TargetGamma...) plus camera pose keys X,Y,Z and Pitch,Roll,Yaw and optional Gimbal{Stabilization,Pitch,Roll,Yaw} (docs/settings.md:136-213, docs/settings_example.json CameraDefaults). 20 deg pitched down = "Pitch": -20 (same sign convention as the Pitch:-90 ground-pointing distance-sensor example). ImageType enum: Scene=0, DepthPlanar=1, DepthPerspective=2, DepthVis=3, DisparityNormalized=4, Segmentation=5, SurfaceNormals=6, Infrared=7, OpticalFlow=8, OpticalFlowVis=9, Annotation=10, ThermalIR=11, NightVision=12 (AirLib/include/common/ImageCaptureBase.hpp:19-35). A stereo-infra pair = two cameras offset in Y (e.g. 0.05 m baseline) each with ImageType 0 requests + one DepthPlanar — this is exactly the pattern the fork's dataset pipeline uses (camera names front_center, stereo_left, stereo_right in dataset_pipeline/configs/smalltown.yaml:36-38).

IMU: SensorType 2; noise params configurable via settings keys AngularRandomWalk, GyroBiasStabilityTau, GyroBiasStability, VelocityRandomWalk, etc. (AirLib/include/sensors/imu/ImuSimpleParams.hpp:52-70, defaults = MPU-6000).

GPULIDAR RESTRICTION: enabling GPULidar (SensorType 8) on SimMode 'Multirotor' throws std::invalid_argument at settings load (AirSimSettings.hpp:1655-1657); docs/gpulidar.md:9 says GPULidar works only in Car and ComputerVision modes. The throw checks simmode_name, not vehicle type, so in SimMode 'Hero' a GPULidar on a drone passes validation (inferred, untested whether it renders). CPU Lidar (SensorType 6) has no such restriction. GPULidar keys: NumberOfChannels, Range, MeasurementsPerCycle, RotationsPerSecond, Resolution, HorizontalFOVStart/End, VerticalFOVUpper/Lower, X/Y/Z, Roll/Pitch/Yaw, GenerateIntensity, GenerateNoise... (docs/gpulidar.md:26-55).
ECHO sensor (radar/sonar-like) = SensorType 7 (docs/echo.md, sensors.md).

PX4 CONNECTION SETTINGS (all parsed in createMavLinkVehicleSetting, AirSimSettings.hpp:866-930): UseSerial, SerialPort, SerialBaudRate, UdpIp, UdpPort, UseTcp, TcpPort, LockStep, ControlIp, ControlPortLocal, ControlPortRemote, LocalHostIp, QgcHostIp/QgcPort, SimSysID/VehicleSysID/OffboardSysID, Model, Logs, plus a Parameters{} map of PX4 params pushed at connect. Defaults (struct MavLinkConnectionInfo, AirSimSettings.hpp:417-470): use_serial=TRUE (serial '*' @115200 — must set "UseSerial": false for SITL), udp 127.0.0.1:14560, use_tcp=false, tcp_port=4560, lock_step=true, control 127.0.0.1 local 14540 / remote 14580.

PX4 SITL RECIPE (docs/px4_sitl.md): build PX4-Autopilot with 'make px4_sitl_default none_iris'; SITL waits on TCP 4560; settings.json vehicle = {"VehicleType": "PX4Multirotor", "UseSerial": false, "UseTcp": true, "TcpPort": 4560, "LockStep": true, "ControlPortLocal": 14540, "ControlPortRemote": 14580} with ClockType SteppableClock and a Barometer sensor with PressureFactorSigma 0.0001825 to keep EKF2 happy (px4_sitl.md:60-92).

PX4 MULTI-VEHICLE (docs/px4_multi_vehicle.md): run N SITL instances via PX4's Tools/sitl_multiple_run.sh N or the fork's PX4Scripts/run_airsim_sitl.sh <i> (sets PX4_SIM_MODEL=iris, runs instance_<i> from Firmware/build/px4_sitl_default); vehicle i uses TcpPort 4560+i, ControlPortLocal 14540+i, ControlPortRemote 14580+i, and distinct X/Y spawn offsets (px4_multi_vehicle.md:33-55).

CLOCK GOTCHA: with any PX4Multirotor vehicle auto-created, default ClockType silently becomes ScalableClock instead of SteppableClock (AirSimSettings.hpp:1553-1567 loadClockSettings) — LockStep requires explicitly setting "ClockType": "SteppableClock" (docs/px4_lockstep.md:10).

PX4-SITL vs SimpleFlight FOR THIS REPRO: AirSim's PX4 integration is MAVLink-only (TCP 4560 simulator protocol + GCS UDP channel); it does NOT emulate uXRCE-DDS. But PX4 SITL itself is a full firmware (commander, EKF2, failsafes, uxrce_dds_client), so the fleet's actual pipeline (vio_bridge -> /fmu/in/vehicle_visual_odometry -> EKF2 EV fusion, offboard_control_mode/trajectory_setpoint writers, Offboard failsafe timeouts) can be reproduced by pointing a MicroXRCEAgent at the SITL instance's uXRCE-DDS UDP port and running the ROS2 stack against it, with AirSim supplying physics+sensors over MAVLink lockstep (inferred — uXRCE side is PX4 behavior, not in this repo). SimpleFlight has none of PX4's mode/failsafe/EKF semantics and cannot reproduce the arming/Offboard/EV-fusion failure classes; it is only useful for perception-side (frontier/nvblox/zenoh) repro.

SIMMODE 'Hero' (heterogeneous, HERCULES-specific): constant at AirSimSettings.hpp:49; ASimModeWorldHero supports vehicle types simpleflight, physxcar, px4multirotor, arducoptersolo (Unreal/Plugins/AirSim/Source/Vehicles/Multirotor/SimModeWorldHero.cpp:135-140) — so PX4-in-the-loop drones work inside Hero mode too. Reference Hero settings.json (PythonClient/hero/multi_agent_drone_car.py:13-30): SimMode 'Hero' with Husky1 (CPHusky) + Drone1 (SimpleFlight). Hero mode exposes TWO RPC servers: drones on port 41451, ground vehicles on 41452 (multi_agent_drone_car.py:34-40 connects MultirotorClient(41451) and CarClient(41452); hercules-multiterminal.yaml launches airsim_node_hercules.launch.py twice with host_port 41451 and 41452).

PURE MULTI-DRONE: plain SimMode 'Multirotor' with multiple named vehicles in Vehicles{} (NED X/Y/Z + Yaw spawn offsets) is fully supported (docs/multi_vehicle.md:1-50); 4 SimpleFlight or 4 PX4Multirotor drones is just 4 entries.

All three files are PX4 v1.15.2 QGC param dumps for 'Vehicle 1' in /home/lucas/hercules-sim/src/multirobot_launch_scripts/px4_params/: STABLE = prometheus_uav_STABLE_WORKS_PERFECTLY_WO_VIO_PX4_params_july-15-2025.params (1080 lines), VIO15 = prometheus_uav_VIO_fused_PX4_params_july-15-2025.params (1086 lines), VIO5 = prometheus_uav_VIO_fused_PX4_params_july-5-2025.params (1086 lines).

XRCE-DDS bridge: STABLE has UXRCE_DDS_CFG=0 (client OFF — the 'works perfectly' config never runs the DDS/VIO link); both VIO files have UXRCE_DDS_CFG=104 (TELEM4) + SER_TEL4_BAUD=921600 (VIO15:939,1076-1081), matching the MicroXRCEAgent serial 921600 link; UXRCE_DDS_SYNCT=1 (timesync on), UXRCE_DDS_DOM_ID=0, UXRCE_DDS_KEY=1.

EV fusion: EKF2_EV_CTRL=15 (horiz pos + vert pos + vel + yaw all fused) in ALL THREE files, including STABLE (harmless there only because UXRCE_DDS_CFG=0 means no EV data arrives) — VIO15:352, STABLE:346.

EV timing/extrinsics evolution: VIO5 had EKF2_EV_DELAY=0ms, EV_POS_X/Y/Z=0, EKF2_HGT_REF=0 (baro), EKF2_MAG_TYPE=0 (auto mag). VIO15 changed to EKF2_EV_DELAY=33ms (line 353), EV_POS lever arm (0.06,-0.03,-0.08), EKF2_HGT_REF=3 (vision height, line 380), EKF2_MAG_TYPE=5 (mag fusion DISABLED, line 395) — i.e. in the current config yaw AND height come solely from cuVSLAM EV.

GPS is NOT disabled in the VIO config: SYS_HAS_GPS=1, GPS_1_CONFIG=201 (VIO15:483), EKF2_GPS_CTRL=7 (lon/lat + alt + 3D vel fusion) in all three files, COM_ARM_WO_GPS=1. VIO15 additionally sets EKF2_GPS_P_NOISE=0.01 m and EKF2_GPS_V_NOISE=0.01 m/s (VIO15:370,372) vs 0.5/0.3 in STABLE and VIO5 — GPS, when it gets a fix, is trusted at absurd 1-cm confidence alongside EV.

EV quality/gates: EKF2_EV_QMIN=0 (no VIO quality gating, VIO15:358), EKF2_EVP_NOISE=EKF2_EVV_NOISE=EKF2_EVA_NOISE=0.1, EKF2_EVP_GATE=5, EKF2_EVV_GATE=3, EKF2_EV_NOISE_MD=0 (use param noise, not VIO-reported covariance). EKF2_DELAY_MAX=200ms (max sensor timestamp lag EKF will buffer).

Other aiding: EKF2_BARO_CTRL=1 (baro still fused), EKF2_RNG_CTRL=1 (rangefinder conditional aiding for the downward 1D lidar; EKF2_RNG_A_HMAX=5m, RNG_A_VMAX=1m/s, RNG_QLTY_T=1s), EKF2_OF_CTRL=0 (no optical flow), EKF2_NOAID_NOISE=10, EKF2_NOAID_TOUT=5000000 (5 s dead-reckoning before local position declared invalid). EKF2_MULTI_IMU=2.

Offboard failsafes (IDENTICAL in all three files): COM_OF_LOSS_T=1.0 s (offboard signal timeout, VIO15:289), COM_OBL_RC_ACT=0 = fall back to POSITION mode on offboard loss when RC present (VIO15:287); PX4 never re-enters Offboard by itself afterward.

RC-loss failsafes (IDENTICAL in all three): COM_RC_LOSS_T=0.5 s, NAV_RCL_ACT=2 (RC loss -> RETURN/RTL, VIO15:674), COM_RCL_EXCEPT=0 (NO exception for Offboard mode — an RC dropout during offboard triggers RTL, VIO15:298). VIO15/STABLE map a kill switch RC_MAP_KILL_SW=10 (VIO5 had 0); COM_ARM_SWISBTN=1 in july-15 files.

RTL geometry changed in VIO15 only: RTL_RETURN_ALT=1.5 m and RTL_DESCEND_ALT=1.5 m (VIO15:884,889) vs 30/10 m in STABLE and VIO5 — an RC-loss-triggered RTL in the VIO config flies home at 1.5 m through the environment being explored.

Position/velocity validity failsafe (all three): COM_POS_FS_DELAY=1 s, COM_POS_FS_EPH=5 m, COM_VEL_FS_EVH=1 m/s — EKF position variance beyond these while in offboard triggers position-invalid failsafe (descend/land path).
Failure detector (all three): FD_FAIL_P=FD_FAIL_R=60 deg with 0.3 s trigger time (attitude-failure -> flight termination), FD_ACT_EN=1, FD_ESCS_EN=1, COM_ACT_FAIL_ACT=0.

MPC limits (all three): MPC_XY_VEL_MAX=12 m/s, MPC_XY_CRUISE=5, MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP=3, MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN=1.5, MPC_ACC_HOR_MAX=5, MPC_TILTMAX_AIR=45, MPC_XY_ERR_MAX=2, MPC_POS_MODE=4. VIO15 lowers MPC_TKO_SPEED 1.5->1.0 and MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT 2.5->1.5.

Telemetry radio: MAV_0_CONFIG=101 (TELEM1) @ SER_TEL1_BAUD=57600 with MAV_0_RADIO_CTL=1, MAV_0_RATE=1200 B/s — a 57600-baud MAVLink radio link exists on TELEM1; this matches the radiohive LoRa default baud (57600), consistent with the host-side radiohive default port /dev/ttyUSB0@57600 being a mis-target of the PX4 XRCE USB serial.

Non-causes ruled out from params: COM_LOW_BAT_ACT=0 (warn only), NAV_DLL_ACT=0 (datalink loss ignored), COM_OBS_AVOID=0, CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK=0. Remaining VIO15-vs-STABLE diffs are sensor cals, battery cal, MC_ROLLRATE_K 1->3 / I 0.2->0.225, and PWM_AUX pin shuffles (rate-gain diff could matter for oscillation but not for 'stuck').
